column1: # manifests/skills.tsv — the global skill store, one row per source repository.
# source
#   source  A spec `skills add` accepts: owner/repo, or owner/repo/path/to/skill.
#   skills  Comma-separated skill names as they appear in the store. Authoritative
#           for skills installed from a source: the sync prunes any the lock
#           records and this file does not list. A skill you wrote yourself has
#           no lock entry, so it is never in scope here and needs no row.
#   mode    select — pass `--skill <skills>`; the repo carries more than we want.
#           whole  — the source spec already names exactly what we want.
# Skill names are the `name:` in each SKILL.md, which is what `--skill` matches.
# They are not always the repo's directory name (react-best-practices installs as
# vercel-react-best-practices), so take them from `skills add <source> -l`.
